# appgatesdp_risk_model (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `high_sensitivity` (Attributes) Sensitivity settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--high_sensitivity))
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `low_sensitivity` (Attributes) Sensitivity settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--low_sensitivity))
- `medium_sensitivity` (Attributes) Sensitivity settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--medium_sensitivity))
- `ztp_rule_id` (String) ID of the rule in ZTP to use as the source of the risk score.

Read-Only:

- `low_risk` (Attributes) Risk definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--high_sensitivity--low_risk))
- `medium_risk` (Attributes) Risk definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--high_sensitivity--medium_risk))

<a id="nestedatt--high_sensitivity--high_risk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `high_sensitivity.high_risk`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action to take for the risk level.
- `deny_message` (String) Enter to show a Display Message User Action to the user when the action is Deny.
- `user_action` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--high_sensitivity--high_risk--user_action))

<a id="nestedatt--high_sensitivity--high_risk--user_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `high_sensitivity.high_risk.user_action`

Read-Only:

- `claim_suffix` (String) Suffix to be added to the claim. Required for OtpAuthentication, PasswordAuthentication and Reason remedy methods.
- `message` (String) Message to be shown to the user. Required for all remedy method.
- `provider_id` (String) MFA Provider Id or Identity Provider Id. Required for some remedy method.
- `type` (String) User Action type.
